title: Deiva Thirumagal
desc: Krishna, a man with intellectual disability, fights for the custody of his young daughter Nila. He convinces lawyer Anuradha to fight his case, when his father-in-law takes his daughter away from him.

title: Adutha Saattai
desc: Dayalan, a dedicated college professor, works extensively in order to empower students to speak up against societal prejudices.

title: Thalapathi
desc: Surya, a courageous man who gets raised in the slums, fights for the rights of the poor. However, he becomes friends with Deva, who hires him as his commander and changes his life completely.

title: Idhaya Thirudan
desc: To rebel against her mother, Deepika, a young girl, sends explicit pictures of herself to a fictitious email address. However, the pictures are received by a real person and the two fall in love.

title: Anegan
desc: Madhu, an animator, gets thoughts about her past life, but her psychiatrist believes it to be a figment of her imagination. Later, Madhu meets Ashwin, the man she was in love with in her past life.
